title: Column visibility, reorder and resize each expose a keyboard-reachable alternative to any drag pointer path
asA: operator who cannot drag with a pointer
iWant: column visibility, reorder and resize to expose a non-drag path so the column layout is fully operable from the keyboard
soThat: WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements is met and the surface stays operable on assistive input devices

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable, the surface exposes a non-drag path to reorder columns: a paired move-left / move-right button per column, or a menu ordering. The check reads the initial header order, activates a move-left control on a middle column, and asserts the header order changed. Probed by pack check AC-17106-1.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with more than one column
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates a keyboard-reachable move control on a column
acceptanceCriteria.then: the header order changes to reflect the move

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable, the column visibility toggle exposes a keyboard-reachable control (a checkbox or menu item) per toggleable column; activating the control hides or shows that column and its header cell without a page reload.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with toggleable columns
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates a column visibility control
acceptanceCriteria.then: the target column's header and body cells hide or show accordingly

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable that supports column resize, the surface exposes a keyboard-reachable resize path (an increment or decrement control per column, or an equivalent menu option) so the width is operable without a pointer drag.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable that supports column resize
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates the keyboard resize path on a column
acceptanceCriteria.then: the column width changes by the declared increment without a pointer drag

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a drag-only reorder or resize control (no keyboard alternative surface), the pack fails the check per REQ-006 and WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements; a passing surface exposes a paired button pair (move-left / move-right, resize-up / resize-down) or a menu ordering per column reachable by Tab.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a datatable whose reorder or resize is pointer-drag-only
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the keyboard-alternative surface
acceptanceCriteria.then: the check fails; a passing surface exposes a paired button or menu ordering reachable by Tab

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the column visibility toggle activated to hide a column, when the pack re-renders the table, the hidden column is removed from the DOM AND from the paired header/data cell binding (no orphan `<td>` rows narrower than the visible column count); a shell that leaves orphan cells fails the pack check.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a column visibility toggle activated to hide a column
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the rendered rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: the column is removed from the DOM and each row's cell count matches the visible column count; orphan cells fail

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a hidden column with an active sort or filter, when the operator hides the column, the sort or filter remains applied to the underlying query (the operator did not de-select the sort; hiding is presentation only) and the accessible copy near the chrome names the retained sort or filter so the operator can see why the visible rows narrowed.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a hidden column that carries an active sort or filter
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the shell after hiding
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sort or filter remains applied to the query and the accessible chrome names the retained state
